items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: The Piper, one we played, I played with Klein, one trampone and one guitar.

ctx.x: And get the instruments. What instruments?

I can. You say, what instruments did they play? The Piper, one we played, I played with Klein, one trampone and one guitar. They don't play no more neither. They even, they were dating to my cousin, you know, two miles, you know. Victor and them. Here they come here.
